wins: Identified open port 445 on target and confirmed SMB service with banner grab, enabling scoped lateral movement planning
Captured baseline host enumeration data for Windows share permissions despite failing to escalate privileges
fails: Unable to obtain administrator token after exhausting classic privilege escalation vectors (UAC bypass, service misconfiguration)
No persistence mechanism established before session expiration, leaving later exploitation steps impossible
Final exploit attempt failed due to insufficient privilege context, resulting in 0% success rate
key_outcomes.summary: Initial reconnaissance was effective and service enumeration data collected, yet privilege escalation and persistence steps consistently failed, preventing mission success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts (local token impersonation and service binary replacement) terminated due to access denied errors

skill_cards.if_condition: When SMB port 445 responds with Microsoft-DS signature
skill_cards.then_action: Invoke targeted SMB enumeration with enum4linux and smbclient to list shares and policy data

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial shell lacks administrator privileges on Windows target
skill_cards.then_action: Gather local user token rights and service configurations before attempting UAC bypass

skill_cards.if_condition: When persistence is necessary but no administrator token acquired yet
skill_cards.then_action: Use scheduled task creation with current low-privilege account to capture session before privilege escalation

Structured privilege checks highlighted missing admin rights before further escalation
